comments.text_zh: 睡够了吗？绝对值得一看：[VIDEO] 就我个人而言，我发现做一份全职编程工作彻底摧毁了我下班后的动力和生产力。也许值得试试先转到一个新行业工作一段时间，或者和雇主谈成某种兼职安排——你可能会发现自己的大脑在下班后痒痒地想写代码、做出点东西。
comments.text: Getting enough sleep? Definitely worth a watch: [VIDEO] Personally, I found that taking a full-time programming job destroyed my out-of-office motivation and productivity. It might be worth trying a job in a new industry for a while, or working out some sort of part-time agreement with your employer -- you might find your brain itching to code and produce something after work hours.

comments.why_zh: Dement 关于睡眠债的研究发现，讲得随意但很有价值。
comments.quote_zh: 其中的信息对任何感到疲惫的人来说可能都极有价值
comments.text_zh: 备受赞誉的斯坦福睡眠研究者 William Dement 在刻画疲劳和困倦方面做了大量工作。总的来说，他的结论是睡眠债极其普遍，而且也有害。他在 Google 做了一场一小时的演讲，讲了他的许多研究结果。他的讲法比较随意，也有点拖沓，但其中的信息对任何感到疲惫的人来说可能都极有价值：[VIDEO] Personal Growth Series: Dr. William Dement on Healthy Sleep and Optimal Performance
comments.text: Lauded Stanford sleep researcher William Dement has done a lot of work to characterize fatigue and drowsiness. Generally speaking his conclusion is that sleep debt is extremely common and also damaging. He gave an hour talk at Google going over many of his results. His manner in this is informal and drags a bit but the information is potentially extremely valuable for anyone experiencing the feeling of tiredness: [VIDEO] Personal Growth Series: Dr. William Dement on Healthy Sleep and Optimal Performance

comments.author: watwut
comments.story_title: Thomas Edison and the Cult of Sleep Deprivation
comments.why_zh: 睡眠实验显示，补足睡眠债后表现会提升。
comments.text_zh: 相关的 Google tech talk：[VIDEO] 他在中间某处描述了他们在睡眠方面做的实验。基本上，他们找了一个人，让他大量睡眠，然后测量表现差异。表现提升了。大量睡眠指的是睡到足以从睡眠债中恢复，然后每晚大约 8 小时。
comments.text: Related google tech talk: [VIDEO] Somewhere in the middle he describes experiments they made with sleep. Essentially, they took a person, made them sleep a lot and then measured performance difference. Performance went up. Sleep a lot meant sleep enough to recover from sleep dept and then around 8 hours every night.

comments.author: smartbit
comments.why_zh: 健康年轻人的平衡睡眠时长约为 8:15。
comments.quote_zh: Dement 演讲中很有意思的一点是，完全健康的年轻人的平衡每日平均睡眠时长为 8:15 ± 50 分钟 [1]。
comments.text_zh: William Dement 在 2008 年 9 月 23 日做了一场 Google Tech talk。Dement 回忆说，1964 年 Randy Gardner 曾连续 11 天不睡觉；大约 40 年后被问到“你还会这么做吗？”时，他回答：“绝对不会再这么做了” [0]。Dement 演讲中很有意思的一点是，完全健康的年轻人的平衡每日平均睡眠时长为 8:15 ± 50 分钟 [1]。我遇到的大多数人都质疑这些结果，并声称自己每天睡不到 7 小时 25 分钟也能以最佳状态工作。[0] [VIDEO] [1] [VIDEO]
comments.text: William Dement gave a Google Tech talk on September 23, 2008. Dement recalls that Randy Gardner who stayed awake for 11 days in 1964, when asked some 40years later " would you do this again? " he replied " No way would I do this again " [0] Very interesting from Dement's talk is that equilibrium daily average sleep for completely health young adults is 8:15 ± 50min [1]. Most people I meet contest these results and state that they can work optimal with less than 7h25m daily sleep. [0] [VIDEO] [1] [VIDEO]
